compute.sign: (() => { const p = { album_id: input.params.albumId, timestamp: input.now * 1000, src: 'lw', user_id: '', vip_status: '0', vip_type: '-1', device_id: 'aaaaaaaabbbbbbbb', app_version: '17.071.25717', scale: '100' }; const base = Object.keys(p).sort().map((k) => k + '=' + p[k]).join('&'); const sign = md5(base + '&secret_key=howcuteitis').toUpperCase(); const all = Object.assign({}, p, { sign }); const qs = Object.keys(all).map((k) => encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(all[k])).join('&'); return { url: 'https://mesh.if.iqiyi.com/tvg/v2/selector?' + qs }; })()
compute.decode: (() => { const up = (u) => u ? String(u).replace(/(_\d{2,4}_\d{2,4})?\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)(\?.*)?$/i, '_720_405.$2$3') : u; const groups = (input.body && input.body.data && input.body.data.videos) || []; const items = []; for (const g of groups) { for (const v of (g.data || [])) { if (v.page_url) { items.push(Object.assign({}, v, { image_hd: up(v.image_url) })); } } } return { items }; })()
